sentences.text: 4. Sri Rajiv Gupta, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel is present for the State- respondent.

5. The petitioner has prayed for a direction to respondent no.2 i.e. District Magistrate, Mathura to ensure payment of compensation to him for Gata No. 291, Khasra No. 669, area 0.664 hectare situated at Sakitara, Tehsil Goverdhan, District Mathura as per the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Re-settlement Act, 2013 and for a further direction to him to pass appropriate order on the applications of the petitioner dated 18.10.2022 and 4.5.2023.
6.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Re-settlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
The case of the petitioner is that the respondents are pressurizing him to execute the sale-deed in respect of aforesaid land as they require it for 'Governdhan Parikrama Marg'.
7.

The petitioner's aforesaid applications mention that the respondents have offered two times the circle rate as compensation, to which the petitioner is not agreeable, still is being compelled to execute the sale-deed, therefore, he should not be dispossessed illegally, unless compensation is paid to him as per the provisions of the Act.

8. Sri Rajiv Gupta, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel, states that the respondents would pay the compensation to the petitioner as per the provisions of the Act, in case they require his land.

9. In view of the aforesaid stand of the State-respondent, we dispose of the instant petition by providing that the petitioner shall not be dispossessed from his aforesaid land, unless adequate compensation, in accordance with law, is paid to him.

It is further provided that the petitioner shall not be compelled to execute the sale-deed, unless the parties arrive at consensus regarding the amount to be paid to the petitioner as compensation/sale consideration.

(Donadi Ramesh, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.)
